questions.question: How does useState work and when should you use a functional update?
questions.title: useState and functional updates
questions.direct_answer: useState gives a component state value and a setter that schedules a re-render. Use the functional form, setCount(c => c + 1), when the next value depends on the previous value or multiple updates may be batched.
